method: Deterministic Node VM tests with parsed markup, a minimal DOM double and stubbed device-sharing APIs. No browser execution or real messages sent.

tests.name: V2.1 · Pause reuses the starting screen and button; only the action label changes
01 · All ten tables; 55 canonical pairs and 100 presentations
02 · Defaults are tables 1–10, Normal 6 s, mastery 3
03 · Ten digits + backspace + submit; three-digit cap; no premature submission
04 · Settings discard unanswered question, keep all scores, and require Continue
05 · Table choices, 6–9 preset, all, and presentation order respect selection
06 · Last active table cannot be removed; invalid empty configuration rejected
07 · Correct answer scores once; input locks during green feedback
08 · Wrong answer shows red + correction; updates accuracy and resets global streak
09 · Timeout is wrong once, reveals answer, and advances after 1050 ms
10 · Three consecutive correct answers master a pair; intervening error resets it
11 · Weighted draw favours frequent/recent errors and subtly favours slow answers
12 · Cancelled and already-queued timers cannot score a subsequent question
13 · Reset clears the round and all timers; old callbacks remain inert
14 · Full default round: all 55 mastered after 165 correct; result metrics and replay
15 · Every requested DOM reference and accessible ID resolves
16 · JavaScript parses; real page uses local files and no fixed or viewport-height layout
Additional · No time limit, keyboard digits/backspace/Enter, one-digit and 100 answers
Additional · Settings during feedback preserves scored answer; changed goal keeps scores
Additional · Hidden page pauses until explicit resume; skipped time is excluded
Additional · SafeClock clearTimeout and clearInterval; old feedback callback inert
Additional · Stale score after reset rejected; question IDs never reused
V2 · Manual pause discards partial input without changing attempts, streak or mastery
V2 · Pausing during feedback keeps the result but kills the next-question callback
V2 · Pausing the final feedback still opens complete results exactly once
V2 · Hidden document is detected even if a timeout callback runs before visibilitychange
V2 · blur/pagehide/pageshow preserve chosen settings and never auto-resume
V2 · Table/time/mastery changes keep per-pair history, attempts and response times
V2 · All 13 reference languages have matching keys and placeholder sets
V2 · Every language updates the actual controls and preserves round statistics
V2.2 · App Block keeps the game visible and explains native-sharing availability
V2.2 · Settings toggles and sharing return to the same paused game without a submenu
V2 · Reset keeps language and practice settings; old callbacks cannot resurrect the round
V2 · More mastery required after completion returns to Continue with the existing record
V3 · Header uses the frameless X asset and keeps its existing dimensions
V2.2 · Published link uses the current app address, excluding query, hash and index filename
V3 · Settings survive closing before the first game and do not start a countdown
V3 · Hard close during an unanswered question restores scores but skips that question

V3 · Pair streaks, response times and inactive-table history round-trip faithfully

V3 · Reset removes the previous round while preserving language and practice choices

V3.1 · Reveal is unavailable while entering an answer, paused or in Settings
